item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 03/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold winter monsoon will persist over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Besides, clouds will thin out and the weather will improve over the region with relatively large temperature difference between day and night. The monsoon is expected to be replaced by an easterly airstream early next week, temperatures will rise slightly with a few rain patches over Guangdong. Another surge of the monsoon will affect Guangdong midweek next week. Temperatures will fall again over the region.
